fixture_form: Source-bound fixtures and mutation recipes, not adapter test results

fresh_observer_recipe.expected_behavior: A fixed plan is returned; recovery callback count stays zero until the external worker acts.
One durable intent/dispatch exists for identical input; changed material rejects with no replacement.
Digest check rejects; no Operation call or progress advancement.
Occurrence IDs and invocation identities differ; each can apply once.
Preflight rejects the whole plan; first Operation call count remains zero.
Exactly one expected-version transition commits; losing worker changes no progress/outbox.
Reopen observes neither transition nor outbox before commit, and both after; ambiguous client outcome reconciles by version and transition identity.
Completed prefix remains; no completed occurrence becomes incomplete.
One claim becomes current; the other acquisition is rejected without starting an attempt.
Each replacement fence is greater than its predecessor; exactly one current claim remains.
Both commits reject; valid current claim plus latest active lease permits bounded advancement.
Renewal keeps fence and increments generation; older generation rejects; no new attempt from renewal.
A cannot commit progress/outcome; B preserves the stable invocation identity and the ledger prevents duplicate application.
No attempt exists for acquisition/renewal; two execution starts have distinct IDs and consecutive numbers.
Intent, plan, Operation binding, occurrence and invocation identity stay equal; attempt identity differs.
Exactly one business effect and Operation outbox record exist; matching replay returns the stored result.
Attempt is unknown before successor handling; late success cannot commit under stale authority. Expiry before invocation creates no attempt.
No early invocation; schedule and budget survive restart; maximum three starts per occurrence, then exhausted without a fourth call.
Reject drift; retain the original plan and no substituted call.
Final dispositions are completed/exhausted/exhausted/escalated with evidence; only completed is satisfied; all terminal retry requests reject.
Business change, success ledger and Operation outbox are all absent; coordinator owns no business writes or remote effects.
First incomplete occurrence resumes; completed progress and exact identities persist. A fully terminal dispatch launches nothing.
Dependent result is not_evaluable/unsupported with causal evidence; never manufacture PASS or terminal disposition.
Invocation/delivery may repeat; business application count stays one through the Operation ledger; no exactly-once process claim.
Attempt failed/unknown does not alone change required; only terminal evidence projects satisfied/unresolved.
Concern-specific records form; universal Port rejects; generated signatures do not count as concrete adapters.
Formation alone has no runtime guarantee; only exact resource/version observations establish bounded persistence.
Each local participant set is all-or-none; business success can coexist temporarily with incomplete coordination; replay reconciles without a cross-file transaction.
First records escalation without retry; second uses persisted bounded schedule. Classification alone grants neither.
Fail closed before invocation/advancement; complete matching composition remains eligible for tests, not automatically proven durable.
